description: Build a link that opens IFC models with the drawings pane beside the 3D view and a floor plan already cut from the model. In that pane the user can also drop DXF or PDF drawings, place them over the model, calibrate the scale, compare plan against model, add dimensions and text, and export to DXF, SVG or PDF. Use it when the user wants a 2D plan, to check a drawing against the model, or to mark up a sheet.

lang.description: Interface language: en, es, ca, fr, de, it, pt, ja, zh or th.

models.description: Public http(s) URLs of IFC files. Several URLs load together as one federated scene. Local paths do not work here: the browser has to download the file.

name: open_drawings
title: Open technical drawings next to a model
